class: registered re-analysis over the frozen m2/m3 chain tuples; zero model calls, zero native runs; the m4 shipping lever pulled again with the out-of-sample ranker the channel-information-bound analysis found

inputs.pairing: each F2 chain (m2: 12, m3: 12) pairs to the m2 F0 chain of the same (dataset, rep) -- the pairing the m2/m3 receipts use, asserted by control M2_M3_PRIMARY_AND_CENSUS_REPRODUCED

attribution.evidence: m3: both_final and both_best are null, only F0_best - F2_final separates; m4: proxy shipping by pooled_biological_evaluation alone does not eliminate the drag; IB: a leave-one-chain-out ridge ranker on the visible fields ranks truth out of sample (FB8 rho 0.220 p 0.019, FB8+CFG rho 0.392 p 0.0005) -- so an operator strictly better than m4's single proxy exists and has never been used as the shipping operator

lever: ship the cycle the LOCO ranker predicts best instead of the loop's last cycle; the ranker is fitted on the other 35 chains and never sees the chain it ships for; the same operator is applied to F0 for the matched-operator contrast

constants.primary_kind_reason: the controller's full visible information -- the feedback it received plus the configuration it chose; FB8 and CFG are reported alongside and are not gate-bearing

contrasts.convention: d = F0_x - F2_y on wasserstein_distance.mean (lower is better); negative d => F2 worse; 'improvement' = F2_final - F2_ship (> 0 => the lever helped)
contrasts.P0: F0_best - F2_final -- the registered m-series primary; reproduced as a control
contrasts.P1: F0_best - F2_ship[primary] -- the drag under ranker shipping
contrasts.P3: F0_ship[primary] - F2_ship[primary] -- both arms shipped by the same operator (fair)
contrasts.P4: F0_best - F2_best -- oracle both sides (the ceiling of any shipping operator; m3 reports it null)
contrasts.recoverable: F2_final - F2_best -- what any shipping operator could recover at most

controls_consumed_by_the_gates.rule: F0_best - F2_final reproduces -0.008979 (m2) and -0.007414 (m3) to 1e-6, and the F0 best-of-4 regime census reproduces 5/4/3 -- ties the pairing to the frozen receipts
mean(F2_final - F2_best) > 0 pooled and >= 12 of 24 chains have a better earlier cycle -- the contrast could exist
run_time := truth + N(0, 0.25 sd) on a copy (seed 20260904); FB8 ranker shipping must recover >= 0.75 of the recoverable improvement pooled -- the pipeline can ship on an informative channel
100 within-chain truth shuffles (seed 20260903), each tested by RS1's own statistic on the primary kind at 400 flips; rejection rate at alpha in [0.02, 0.09]

gates.RS0_CONTROLS_VALID: all four controls PASS; a failed control refuses every gate (exit 4)
gates.RS1_SHIPPING_LEVER_HELPS: pooled mean(P2) > 0 with one-sided sign-flip p <= 0.05 (4000 flips, seed 20260904)
gates.RS3_reported: P1 pooled: is the drag still significantly negative under ranker shipping (one-sided p <= 0.05)?

routing.licenses: only a prospectively frozen new line whose shipping operator is the ranker; no revival claim, m6 not authorized

routing.reading: intermediate; the residual is attributed to the loop's per-cycle configuration choices, not to shipping
the shipping lever class is saturated on this substrate

pre_run_reachability_audit.seed_does_something: sign flips, the plant, the null-calibration shuffles
pre_run_reachability_audit.hard_gate_at_scale: 36 LOCO fits per kind, 100 null reps x 36 fits; pure Python, no crash path
pre_run_reachability_audit.clause_narrowing: the runner evaluates exactly the gates above; the selftest asserts the constants here equal the script's
pre_run_reachability_audit.parent_isolation: none -- P3 applies the identical operator to both arms; P1 keeps the registered oracle parent so the claim stays comparable with m2/m3/m4

pre_run_expectation_disclosed: the IB rollup's top-1 hit rates (0.39-0.42 against 0.25 chance) were seen before this design was written; they suggest partial recovery. Stated so that neither a partial nor an exhausted outcome can be read afterwards as a surprise.
no_rescue_clause: no constant, kind, gate, threshold, seed, pairing or routing row may change after the rollup is computed
